note: The six review keyframes. Fixed for every review round: real frames of the desktop walk (1600 x 900), rendered by `node corridor3d/render.mjs stills`. `frame` is the walk frame index; "scare" is the held frame the scare plays over (layout.js scareFrameIndex).

stills.name: 1-start
stills.why: the first frame: tight to the left wall in the dark under a dying lamp, the first pool of light and the shoe six metres off

stills.name: 2-mid
stills.why: mid walk, on the right of the corridor: the swinging lamp half in the frame overhead, the open clawed door, the dark beyond

stills.name: 3-scratched-door
stills.why: the walker glances at the inside of door 305: the gouges at hand height, the black room behind the leaf

stills.name: 4-scare-door-closed
stills.why: the held walk frame at door 308, before it opens

stills.name: 5-scare
stills.why: the scare at its peak, stand-in face (variant f), as the patch is laid over the held frame

stills.name: 6-last-door
stills.why: the end of the walk: tight to the right wall, door 313 in the one pool of light
